name: Question 2
problem:
| ${x}_{1}$ | **$-2$** | **$-1$** | **$0$** | **$1$** | **$2$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${x}_{2}$ | **$6$** | **$11$** | **$8$** | **$20$** | **$24$** |
| $y$ | $0$ | $-1$ | $4$ | $9$ | $16$ |

The vector of coefficients of the plane $y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}{x}_{1}+{\beta }_{2}{x}_{2}$ that best fits the data above can be found using multi linear regression as 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2}\end{aligned}]=({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}{X}^{T}y,
$$

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector. Which of the following is the observation vector $y$ in this context?
worked_solution:
| ${x}_{1}$ | **$-2$** | **$-1$** | **$0$** | **$1$** | **$2$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${x}_{2}$ | **$6$** | **$11$** | **$8$** | **$20$** | **$24$** |
| $y$ | $0$ | $-1$ | $4$ | $9$ | $16$ |

The coefficients of the plane 

$$
y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}{x}_{1}+{\beta }_{2}{x}_{2}
$$

that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution $\overset{^}{\beta }$ to the system 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{X}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 6 \\ 1 & -1 & 11 \\ 1 & 0 & 8 \\ 1 & 1 & 20 \\ 1 & 2 & 24\end{aligned}]}}\overset{\beta }{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2} \\ {\beta }_{3}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{y}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1 \\ 4 \\ 9 \\ 16\end{aligned}]}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $X$ is the design matrix, $\beta $ is the parameter vector, and $y$ is the observation vector.
